findings.governingReading: Shirou says plainly that he does not want Saber to die even if the attack defeats Berserker.
findings.explanation: Disappear replaces his personal language of death with the Servant-system euphemism and weakens the emotional reason for his request.

findings.governingReading: Saber states her refusal to use the Noble Phantasm firmly and without qualification.
findings.explanation: Declares so omits the decisive firmness that reassures Shirou.

findings.evidenceJa: 今は、それがひどく嬉しい
findings.governingReading: At this moment, Saber’s firm answer makes Shirou intensely happy.
findings.explanation: The English removes both the immediate temporal focus and the strength of his relief.

findings.governingReading: Saber makes an outrageous comic observation that complaining at Shirou seems to be Rin’s hobby.
findings.explanation: Ominous invents foreboding and suppresses the teasing absurdity.

findings.evidenceJa: 後ろから手を引っ張る
findings.governingReading: Shirou hurriedly pulls Saber’s hand from behind to keep her from pitching forward.
findings.explanation: Grab omits the pulling support and his position behind her.

findings.governingReading: Shirou warns Saber to watch her footing among the scattered rubble.
findings.explanation: The spoken line lacks closing punctuation.

findings.highlight: Her figure looks like me from earlier
findings.evidenceJa: ついさっきまでの自分を見ているよう
findings.governingReading: Seeing Saber’s growing embarrassment feels like seeing his own state moments earlier.
findings.explanation: Her figure looks like me asserts physical resemblance and loses the mirrored emotional state.

findings.governingReading: Holding her palm makes Shirou vividly recall the tactile feel of Saber.
findings.explanation: Saber’s sensations assigns the experience to her and changes what Shirou remembers touching into feelings she experienced.

findings.governingReading: The pair quicken their pace through a forced exchange meant to escape mutual embarrassment.
findings.explanation: Start to go removes the acceleration and weakens the abrupt retreat.

findings.evidenceJa: 戻ってくる事などはないだろう
findings.governingReading: Shirou expects that once they leave, they probably will not return to the ruined shelter.
findings.explanation: The English turns his outlook into an absolute future fact.

findings.highlight: head to the battlefield. battlefield, suppressing my beating heart.
findings.evidenceJa: 戦場へ向かっていった
findings.governingReading: After one final look at the ruined house, Shirou heads toward the battlefield.
findings.explanation: The English repeats battlefield and appends an unsupported heartbeat clause absent from the Japanese.
